title: Ultra Sound Guided Fine Needle Aspiration Cytology (FNAC) of Liver and Pancreas Tumours
brief_summary: Patients with tumors in liver or pancreas are randomized to ultrasound (UL)-guided FNAC biopsies with guidance method or UL-guided FNAC biopsies with free-hand method.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* adult over 18 years
* tumors in liver and/or pancreas

Exclusion Criteria:

* low coagulation factors
* mentally ill patients.
